# Tsai Orthodontics

> Tsai Orthodontics is a specialist orthodontic practice at 3431 Main Street, Vancouver, BC, offering braces, Invisalign and early (Phase I) treatment for children, teens and adults. Dr. Andrew Tsai is a certified specialist in orthodontics. The first consultation is complimentary, no referral is needed, and care is offered in English and Mandarin (staff also speak Cantonese).

The practice is led by Dr. Andrew Tsai and Dr. Marjorie Tsai. Its approach rests on four beliefs — Craft, Care, Clarity and Convenience — with specialist-led, personalized treatment plans for Vancouver families.

The site is also available in Traditional Chinese under /zh-tw/, e.g. https://tsaiorthodontics.ca/zh-tw/.

## Practice details

- Address: 3431 Main Street, Vancouver, BC V5V 3M9, Canada
- Phone: 604-636-2686
- Email: smile@tsaiorthodontics.ca
- Hours: Tuesday – Saturday, 10:00 am – 6:00 pm; closed Sunday and Monday
- Languages: English and Mandarin; staff also speak Cantonese

## Common questions

- Referral: not required — patients can book a complimentary consultation directly.
- First visit: an unhurried conversation, a careful clinical look and, if helpful, a quick digital scan. Patients leave knowing whether treatment is needed and the next step.
- Consultation fee: none, and no obligation.
- Orthodontist vs dentist: an orthodontist completes an additional two to three years of full-time specialist training focused on tooth movement, bite and facial development.
- Appointments: most patients are seen every six to eight weeks; aligner patients often have longer intervals.
- Insurance: the practice works with most major insurance plans and submits claims on the patient's behalf wherever possible.
- Payment plans: in-house monthly financing with no interest for the length of treatment.
- Fees: not listed online because every case is different; clear, written fees are provided at the consultation.
- Families: multiple family members can often be seen on the same day.
- After treatment: custom retainers, a wear schedule and follow-up visits for up to a year.
- Patients treated elsewhere: welcome for retainer replacement, check-ins or continuing care after a move.
